e: Nothing good is without a flaw
Guard carefully what is precious and irreplaceable to you
Everyone has their own kind of intelligence
Don't exaggerate or create problems where none exist.
s: Hakuna kitu kizuri ambacho hakina kasoro.
Linda kwa makini kitu chako cha thamani ambacho hakibadilishwi.
Kila mtu ana aina yake ya akili na uwezo.
d: Takuna chitu chinono duniani ambacho tachina ila fulani — ukamilifu taupo.
Linda kpwa makini chitu chako cha thamani ambacho tachiweza kubadilishwa.
Chila mutu ana aina yakpwe ya achili na uwezo, hata ichikala inaonekana kpwa njira tofauti.
Usihende tatizo kulu kula kpwa dzambo ambaro tarikuko.

exp.e:

Literal: Intelligence is like hair, everyone has some
Meaning: Everyone has their own kind of intelligence
exp.s:
Achili ni nyere, chila mmwenga ana zakpwe
Tafsiri halisi: Akili ni kama nywele, kila mmoja ana zake
Maana: Kila mtu ana aina yake ya akili na uwezo.

s: Mtu huokolewa na juhudi zake mwenyewe.
Binadamu hujitahidi lakini matokeo ni ya Mungu.
Mtu aliyeshiba hawezi kuelewa hali ya mwenye njaa.

Mutu ahendaye hoyo sana katafanikiwa; utulivu ndio una nguvu.

Uchiendelea kutsokola bila kujali, mwisho undaamsha chitu chenye nguvu zaidi ya uwezo wako.

q.e:
Which proverb means:
"Your habits and actions take root wherever you go — you cannot outrun their consequences."
q.s:
Methali ipi ina maana ya:
"Mahali unapozurura ndipo unapopanda; matendo yako yanafuata nyayo zako."
q.d:
Ndarira ipi ina madzo ga:
"Matendo gako ganakufuata phophosi uendapho; tauweza kukimbira matokeo ga tabiya zako."
